name: Retroid Pocket 5

gamepad.name: Retroid Pocket Controller
gamepad.glyphSource: Printed on the face buttons: A right, B bottom, X top, Y left, whatever the layout toggle is set to (owner, read on the console 2026-10-08).
gamepad.notes: The d-pad reports BOTH the hat axes and the BTN_DPAD_* keys, so a reader that consumes both sees every press twice.

source: Read from the console itself on 2026-09-10: /proc/bus/input/devices and `getevent -pl` for the pad, the running display mode for the panel.

0.note: The system button-layout toggle set to "Retro", the Nintendo layout (owner, read on the console 2026-10-02): each button reports the key code of what is printed on it, so the right button (printed A) reports BUTTON_A, and confirm is on the right button. Against Android's positional key codes (A bottom, B right, X left, Y top) A/B and X/Y are swapped. The toggle has a third setting, "Disabled", whose value has not been observed and is not listed.

1.note: The system button-layout toggle set to "xbox" (owner, read on the console 2026-10-02): key codes by position, Xbox-style, so the bottom button (printed B) reports BUTTON_A, and confirm is on the bottom button. In this position the pad reports itself as "Xbox Wireless Controller" instead of the gamepad name above (NetherSX2's input log on the console, 2026-10-02).

layoutToggle.source: Property name read on the console itself on 2026-10-02 (ro.product.model=Retroid Pocket 5); value 1 is the toggle's "xbox" position and value 0 its "Retro" (Nintendo) position (owner, 2026-10-02, corrected from the first reading, which had 0 and 1 the other way round).

displaysSource: The internal panel's mode was read from the console on 2026-09-10. The add-on display sits physically above the built-in one (owner, 2026-10-02). The add-on's native mode, 1080x1920 portrait, is from its own DRM mode list read on the console (droidtop DisplayModes, where it was seen falling back to 480x640); droidtop matches it by that exact size, so a landscape monitor on the same DisplayPort is not taken for the add-on.
